meta.title: Doubao Web Image Agent Tool
meta.description: Registers doubao_generate_image and doubao_image_status natively, driving Doubao Web (doubao.com) through the local ego lite Profile 1 by default, picking the watermark-free wm0 2.7K original, saving it locally and returning it as a multimodal image attachment; falls back to the local Chrome (chrome-devtools-mcp CLI) when ego is unavailable.

enabled.title: Enable Doubao Web Image Agent Tool
enabled.description: Registers doubao_generate_image and doubao_image_status native tools for the Agent.

browserBackend.title: Browser backend
browserBackend.description: ego first: drive Doubao through the already signed-in ego lite Profile 1 (no QR scan, no Electron interpreter trap). chrome uses the chrome-devtools daemon with a dedicated Chrome profile (one QR scan required). auto behaves like ego: falls back to chrome when ego is not detected.

egoCliPath.title: ego lite executable path
egoCliPath.description: Leave empty to auto-detect C:\Program Files\Citro Labs\ego lite\Application\<version>\ego-browser.exe (highest version). Can be overridden with the DSH_EGO_CLI_PATH environment variable.

chromeCliPath.title: chrome-devtools CLI Executable Path
chromeCliPath.description: Path to the chrome-devtools CLI (leave empty to auto-resolve the npm global chrome-devtools.cmd on Windows, or ~/.local/bin/chrome-devtools / chrome-devtools on PATH elsewhere).

doubaoUrl.title: Doubao Web Entry URL
doubaoUrl.description: Target Doubao Web chat URL used for image generation (defaults to https://www.doubao.com/chat/).

defaultAspectRatio.title: Default Aspect Ratio
defaultAspectRatio.description: Default aspect ratio when none is specified in the tool call (1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4).

defaultStyle.title: Default Visual Style Preset
defaultStyle.description: Default visual style appended when none is specified (leave empty or 'auto' for prompt-driven style).

outputDir.title: Local Output Directory
outputDir.description: Directory where downloaded high-resolution Doubao images are saved (relative paths resolve against the workspace, default: doubao_images).

timeoutMs.title: Generation Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for Doubao Web image generation and download (default 120000, range 30000–180000).

keepTab.title: Keep Doubao Tab Open After Generation
keepTab.description: When enabled, retains the Doubao browser tab after generation for follow-up edits and session reuse.

injectSystemPrompt.title: Inject System Prompt Guidance
injectSystemPrompt.description: Injects usage guidance into the Agent system prompt so the model automatically invokes doubao_generate_image when asked to draw.
